description: A modern bar stool with a smooth, contoured seat and back, featuring a distinctive oval cutout in the seat. The seat is upholstered in a warm, tan-colored material, resembling leather or a high-quality fabric. Its sleek, minimalist design is supported by a slender, black metal frame with four tapered legs connected by a circular footrest. The stool's form is elegant and functional, designed for comfort and style in contemporary spaces. It is presented against a plain, neutral background, highlighting its clean lines and sophisticated silhouette. Beside the stool are two small, cube-shaped decorative items, one dark grey and the other a muted green, adding a subtle touch of color and scale.
